data.gender_notes: Darci is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Darci is of unknown origin, but its meaning is believed to be derived from the Latin word dar meaning 'dear' and ci meaning 'light'. In Christian tradition, it is interpreted as 'Daughter of Light'. The name Darci carries the meaning “Daughter of light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Darci usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darci total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
